AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
A Special Meeting of the Signal Hill City Council was held on October 4, 2023 at approximately 11:30 a.m. at Signal HIll Public Library - Signal Point Terrace, 1800 E. Hill Street, Signal Hill, California.

Mayor Hansen presented the State of the City. The presentation included  discussions on the City’s efforts to serve the community; updates on major projects; today’s business climate; and the City’s financial outlook. 

The Special Meeting ended at approximately 1:00 p.m. The next regular meeting of the City Council will be held on Tuesday, October 10, 2023 at 7:00 p.m.
